title: Admissibility under a witness regime replaces truth at the foundation

statements.text: What replaces a bridge-law theory is a structural specification: the conditions a system must meet to be a coherent locus of experience. At the foundational level a theory is judged admissible when its required distinctions are witnessed before it demands an explanation.

sources.quote: Replace truth and falsity, at the foundational level, with admissibility under a witness regime.
